description:
Sierra Delight, the successor to the leader of the Black Panther Clan. She makes the biggest mistake of her life and ends up in a political marriage with a lower-ranking opponent. The opponent is the Rabbit Clan, who competes with the Squirrel Clan in the World’s Best Beasts Tournament and comes in last place. 

*“Yes, divorce. I’ll make it so that you have no choice but to divorce!”* 

She enters the bridal chamber with a heavy heart… 

 *“Haa… Stop it! You horny bunny!!”
“…It’s our first night… Our first… day…”* 

The rabbit who was thought to be weak, … is too strong at night! A naive and gentle rabbit during the day.

 *“It feels so good inside you, Sierra…It’s warm. I want to keep fucking you… I wish we could become one like this…”*

A horny rabbit in heat at night. 

*“…Did I get scammed in a marriage?”*

Will Sierra be able to be satisfied with her rabbit husband?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
